facts.text: MK reaches a golden aura barrier and can pass through it easily.
Macaque cannot get through the golden aura barrier.
MK tries to figure out what to do after Macaque cannot pass the barrier.
MK pulls Macaque through a weakened barrier.
Mei and Tang watch MK and Macaque in surprise.
Mei and Tang seem excited to see their king and bow.
After Macaque emerges, Macaque collapses visibly broken and in pain.
Mei and Tang look sad after Macaque collapses.
MK, Macaque, and the others exit a cave into sunlight.
A golden-haired monkey army is waiting for them.
Wukong stands at the front of the golden-haired monkey army.
Wukong's armor gleams in the sun.
Wukong gives an order for his army to attack while staring at MK.

events.text: MK tests the golden aura barrier and can pass through while Macaque cannot.
MK pulls Macaque through the weakened barrier; Mei and Tang bow, then look sad as Macaque collapses broken and in pain.
MK, Macaque, and the others exit the cave into sunlight and encounter the golden-haired monkey army led by Wukong.
Wukong orders his golden-haired monkey army to attack while staring at MK.
